claim_boundary: These are paper-facing summaries of the causal schema-v3 measured-cache policy-semantics population. Legacy is fixed-cap semantics on the same cache; external policies are not full-stack binary executions. Performance diagnostics are reported even when superiority is false and are never used as input-gate assumptions. Finite completion ratios use only traces on which all registered policies complete; incomplete tails are reported separately and these conditional ratios do not measure overall superiority.
